metadata.chapter_subtitle: Measuring underwater topography with light and sound

inventory.summary: The chapter needed a clearer comparison between optical and acoustic ranging before the detailed geometry.
issues: The chapter lacked the standard onboarding block.
The contrast between light-based and sound-based depth mapping needed stronger early framing.
The geometry-and-correction storyline benefited from a clearer conceptual setup.

rewrite.summary: Completed a full editorial pass that added onboarding and clarified the light-versus-sound comparison.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start block.
Clarified why bathymetric LiDAR and sonar succeed under different water conditions.
Improved the lead-in to travel-time and refraction geometry.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now introduces underwater ranging more clearly while preserving the specialist physics.

repair.summary: The comparison-and-pacing issue was repaired during the editorial pass.
actions_taken: Clarified when optical versus acoustic ranging is appropriate.
Strengthened the geometry-first interpretation of the corrections.

design_review.summary: The chapter's ranging workflow and error-correction visuals now have stronger interpretive support.
improvements_made: Improved interpretive support around why the same travel-time idea behaves differently in light and sound.
